newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan issues June 10-24 MTBE import tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan issues June 10-24 MTBE import tender.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy one to two 3,500-tonne cargoes of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) for June 10-24 delivery, a company official said on Wednesday.
The tender for the octane enhancer for gasoline, seeks offers on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Kaohsiung and Keelung and closes April 28 and is valid for two days.
CPC's last MTBE tender, for 3,500-tonnes for May 6-20 delivery, was awarded to Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) at between $275 to $280 per tonne, c-and-f.
